name: 8 Ball
effect: 1 in 4 chance for each played 8 to create a Tarot card when scored (Must have room)
strategy: Every scored 8 is a lottery ticket for a free Tarot — worth keeping your 8s around early while the build decides what it wants to be. Oops! All 6s doubles the odds.
test_idea: Theory: playing 2+ 8s per round prints more Tarot value than a flat economy joker prints dollars. Track one run and count the Tarots.

name: Abstract Joker
effect: +3 Mult for each Joker card
strategy: +3 Mult per joker means it peaks at +15 with a full board — a solid early bridge that quietly becomes your worst slot late. Classic 'sell it when the shop offers a real payoff' joker.
test_idea: In the optimizer: at what point does a ×1.5 joker beat Abstract's +15? Compare on your usual hand at level 3.

name: Acrobat
effect: X3 Mult on final hand of round
strategy: ×3 but only on your final hand of the round — a closer, not an opener. Strongest when you can bank one giant hand: pair it with hand-size and level investment in a single hand type.
test_idea: Toggle 'final hand' in the optimizer and see whether Acrobat's ×3 finish beats spreading two medium hands.
unlock: Play 200 hands

name: Ancient Joker
effect: Each played card with [suit] gives X1.5 Mult when scored, suit changes at end of round
strategy: ×1.5 per matching-suit card scored, but the suit changes every round. Wild cards and Smeared Joker soften the roulette; mono-suit decks make it a coin flip between dead and dominant.
test_idea: Set Ancient's suit in the optimizer to your flush suit vs. off-suit — measure exactly how much a bad round costs.

name: Arrowhead
effect: Played cards with Spades suit give +50 Chips when scored
strategy: +50 chips per scored Spade is a huge flat battery for spade flushes — chips are usually the scarce half of the equation once your Mult engine is running.
test_idea: Theory: on a lvl-2 spade flush, Arrowhead outscores a generic +Mult joker until your mult passes ~20. Verify.
unlock: Have at least 30 cards with Spade suit in your deck

name: Astronomer
effect: All Planet cards and Celestial Packs in the shop are free
strategy: Free Planet cards and packs turn every shop into hand-leveling. It doesn't score — it compounds your base values so everything else scores harder next ante.
test_idea: Track hand levels over 3 antes with vs. without buying celestials — how many levels does 'free' actually buy?
unlock: Discover every Planet card

name: Banner
effect: +30 Chips for each remaining discard
strategy: +40 chips per remaining discard rewards not discarding — which fights against digging for your hand. Great with disciplined flush/pair builds that don't need to dig.
test_idea: In-game theory: playing greedy (0 discards used) with Banner vs. digging for the better hand — which clears the blind more often?

name: Baron
effect: Each King held in hand gives X1.5 Mult
strategy: ×1.5 per King held in hand is one of the great late-game engines: hoard Kings, play cheap hands, let the held Kings multiply. Wants retriggers (Mime) and steel Kings.
test_idea: Optimizer: play a junk pair while holding 3 Kings — watch Baron beat a 'real' hand played without it.

name: Baseball Card
effect: Uncommon Jokers each give X1.5 Mult
strategy: Every Uncommon joker gains ×1.5 — it converts a board of utility Uncommons into a multiplicative wall. Count your Uncommons before buying; 3+ makes it absurd.
test_idea: Add your actual lineup in the optimizer and count Uncommons — each is worth ×1.5. Compute your board's hidden total.

name: Blackboard
effect: X3 Mult if all cards held in hand are Spades or Clubs
strategy: ×3 if every held card is Spades/Clubs — demands deck sculpting (The Moon/The World tarots) or playing your whole hand. Painful mid-run, monstrous in a black-suit deck.
test_idea: Optimizer: full 5-card plays leave 3 held cards — how often can your current deck keep those 3 all black?

name: Bloodstone
effect: 1 in 2 chance for played cards with Hearts suit to give X1.5 Mult when scored
strategy: Coin-flip ×1.5 on each scored Heart: streaky but massive in heart flushes. Expected value is fine; variance is the real cost — don't bet a must-win blind on it.
test_idea: Compare EV mode vs. Optimist mode on a heart flush in the optimizer — that gap is the risk you're accepting.
unlock: Have at least 30 cards with Heart suit in your deck

name: Blue Joker
effect: +2 Chips for each remaining card in deck
strategy: +2 chips per card left in deck starts big and shrinks as you thin. It's an anti-synergy with deck-thinning builds — strongest in fat, unsculpted decks early.
test_idea: Theory: Blue Joker is worth ~+100 chips in ante 1 and ~+60 by ante 5 in a thinning build. Track your deck count.

name: Blueprint
effect: Copies ability of Joker to the right
strategy: Copies the joker to its right — position is everything. Point it at your best ×Mult or scaling joker and it's the strongest card in the game; point it at economy and you've wasted a Rare.
test_idea: Optimizer: put Blueprint left of your best ×Mult, then left of a +Mult — the score gap is the whole lesson.
unlock: Win a run

name: Bootstraps
effect: +2 Mult for every $5 you have
strategy: +2 Mult per $5 rewards hoarding cash — synergizes with interest-cap economy and punishes shop sprees. A budget bridge that gets better the greedier your wallet.
test_idea: At $25 it's +10 Mult: in the optimizer, find the cash level where Bootstraps beats your other flat-mult option.
unlock: Have at least 2 Polychrome Jokers at the same time.

name: Brainstorm
effect: Copies the ability of leftmost Joker
strategy: Copies your LEFTMOST joker — so it rewards planning your board like a sentence. Leftmost slot becomes sacred: park the thing worth copying there and never move it.
test_idea: Optimizer: Brainstorm + your leftmost ×Mult vs. moving that ×Mult right — prove why slot 1 matters.
unlock: Discard a Royal Flush.

name: Bull
effect: +2 Chips for each $1 you have
strategy: +2 chips per dollar makes your savings account part of the scoring engine. With $40 banked that's +80 chips every hand — economy builds get a combat stat for free.
test_idea: At your usual bank balance, does Bull out-chip a dedicated chip joker? Check in the optimizer.

name: Burglar
effect: When Blind is selected, gain +3 Hands and lose all discards
strategy: +3 hands, zero discards: it converts safety into tempo. Strong with Banner-style no-discard play and card draw; brutal if your build needs to dig for combos.
test_idea: In-game: one full ante never discarding — did the extra hands out-earn the lost selection?

name: Burnt Joker
effect: Upgrade the level of the first discarded poker hand each round
strategy: Upgrades the level of the first hand you discard each round — turns waste into investment. Deliberately discard your money hand first to level it while dumping junk.
test_idea: Theory: Burnt Joker levels your main hand ~2×/ante. Compare against buying planets for the same effect.
unlock: Sell 50 cards.

name: Business Card
effect: Played face cards have a 1 in 2 chance to give $2 when scored
strategy: Face cards flip coins for dollars — it wants face density (Pareidolia turns the whole deck into a payroll). Never a scorer; purely a payroll on cards you were playing anyway.
test_idea: Track one ante: how many $ did face-card coin flips actually pay vs. a flat economy joker?

name: Campfire
effect: This Joker gains X0.25 Mult for each card sold, resets when Boss Blind is defeated
strategy: Gains ×0.5 per card SOLD and resets after each boss — a rhythm joker. Sell aggressively right before boss blinds, cash the multiplier, accept the reset as the price.
test_idea: Enter Campfire's current × in the optimizer before a boss — how many sales does it take to beat a static ×2?

name: Canio
effect: This Joker gains X1 Mult when a face card is destroyed
strategy: Legendary that grows ×1 for every face card destroyed. Pairs with card-destroying tarots/glass faces — you're burning your deck to feed a permanent multiplier.
test_idea: Enter Canio's current × after each destruction — plot how fast controlled demolition scales vs. Hologram.
unlock: Find this Joker from the Soul card.

name: Card Sharp
effect: X3 Mult if played poker hand has already been played this round
strategy: ×3 if you replay a hand type already played this round. Multi-hand rounds only — play a cheap flush to 'prime' it, then the real flush cashes ×3.
test_idea: Optimizer: cheap primer hand + primed ×3 real hand vs. two normal hands — total the round both ways.

name: Cartomancer
effect: Create a Tarot card when Blind is selected (Must have room)
strategy: A free Tarot every blind keeps your sculpting engine fed. Value scales with how well you use Tarots — it's a pick for players with a plan, dead weight without one.
test_idea: Count one run: Tarots consumed via Cartomancer vs. bought — what did the free stream let you skip buying?
unlock: Discover every Tarot card.

name: Castle
effect: This Joker gains +3 Chips per discarded [suit] card, suit changes every round
strategy: Gains chips per discarded card of a chosen suit (changes each round). Discards become deposits — sculpt discards toward the suit and it becomes a monster chip battery.
test_idea: Enter Castle's current chips in the optimizer each ante — is it outpacing Blue Joker's shrinking battery yet?

name: Cavendish
effect: X3 Mult, 1 in 1000 chance this card is destroyed at the end of round
strategy: ×3 with a 1-in-1000 self-destruct: statistically immortal, emotionally terrifying. Take the ×3 and don't think about it.
test_idea: Optimizer: measure what flat ×3 does to your best hand — then decide what odds of loss you'd actually accept for it.

name: Ceremonial Dagger
effect: When Blind is selected, destroy Joker to the right and permanently add double its sell value to this Mult
strategy: Eats the joker to its right on blind select and banks double its sell value as +Mult. Feed it cheap shop jokers like a wood chipper — position and timing are the skill.
test_idea: Enter Dagger's current +Mult in the optimizer — how many $2 sacrifices equal one Rare ×Mult purchase?

name: Certificate
effect: When round begins, add a random playing card with a random seal to your hand
strategy: Adds a random playing card with a seal each round — free deck inflation with upside. Anti-synergy with thin-deck plans; fine in wide 'value pile' decks.
test_idea: Theory: after 4 antes, Certificate's added cards helped more hands than they diluted. Review your run log.
unlock: Have a Gold playing card with a Gold Seal

name: Chaos the Clown
effect: 1 free Reroll per shop
strategy: One free reroll per shop is quietly one of the best economy effects in the game — reroll equity every single shop, forever.
test_idea: Track 3 shops: did the free reroll find something you'd have paid $5+ to see? That's its real yield.

name: Chicot
effect: Disables effect of every Boss Blind
strategy: Legendary that disables boss blind effects — a skeleton key. Its value is exactly the value of the boss you'd otherwise lose to; priceless against your build's counter.
test_idea: List which boss effects actually kill your archetype — Chicot is worth its slot only if that list is long.
unlock: Find this Joker from the Soul card.

name: Clever Joker
effect: +80 Chips if played hand contains a Two Pair
strategy: +80 chips on Two Pair hands — budget glue for pair-spam builds before real engines arrive. Cheap, honest, replaceable.
test_idea: Optimizer: Two Pair + Clever vs. a bare Three of a Kind — which clears an early blind cheaper?

name: Cloud 9
effect: Earn $1 for each 9 in your full deck at end of round
strategy: $1 per 9 in your deck at round end — a savings bond on cards you might never play. Keep your 9s and it pays rent; thin them and it's dead.
test_idea: Count your 9s; multiply by remaining antes. Compare that total against just selling Cloud 9 for quick cash.

name: Constellation
effect: This Joker gains X0.1 Mult every time a Planet card is used
strategy: Gains ×0.1 per Planet used — the definitive slow-burn engine. With Astronomer or celestial packs it snowballs; buy planets you don't even need just to feed it.
test_idea: Enter its current × each ante in the optimizer — find the ante where Constellation passes a flat ×2.

name: Crafty Joker
effect: +80 Chips if played hand contains a Flush
strategy: +80 chips on Flushes — early flush-build filler that bridges you to real multipliers. Sell without sentiment when the engine arrives.
test_idea: Optimizer: at what Mult level does dropping Crafty for a ×1.5 joker become correct on your flush?

name: Crazy Joker
effect: +12 Mult if played hand contains a Straight
strategy: +12 Mult on Straights — the straight build's starter engine. Straights are harder to assemble; make sure Shortcut/Four Fingers support exists before committing.
test_idea: Optimizer: your straight + Crazy vs. your flush + nothing — is the straight line actually ahead yet?

name: Credit Card
effect: Go up to -$20 in debt
strategy: Go up to -$20: it's a loan, not income. Real use is tempo — grabbing the build-defining joker NOW instead of two shops later. Interest math punishes staying negative.
test_idea: Theory: going -$15 for a key engine one ante early beats staying solvent. Try both across two runs and compare antes reached.

name: DNA
effect: If first hand of round has only 1 card, add a permanent copy to deck and draw it to hand
strategy: Play exactly one card on your first hand and it's permanently duplicated. A copy machine for your best card — steel Kings, glass Aces, lucky cards. Slow, deliberate, exponential.
test_idea: Theory: 3 antes of DNA-copying one steel King beats most Rare jokers. Track your King count and Baron math.

name: Delayed Gratification
effect: Earn $2 per discard if no discards are used by end of the round
strategy: $2 per discard if you use none — pays you to not dig. Competes directly with Banner for the same discipline; take one, not both, unless economy is the whole plan.
test_idea: One ante of zero discards: total the payout vs. the blinds where digging would have found a better hand.

name: Devious Joker
effect: +100 Chips if played hand contains a Straight
strategy: +100 chips on Straights — same job as Crafty but for the straight lane. Filler that buys time.
test_idea: Optimizer: Devious on a lvl-2 straight vs. nothing on a lvl-3 flush — which line is actually winning?

name: Diet Cola
effect: Sell this card to create a free Double Tag
strategy: Sell it for a free Double Tag — it's a coupon disguised as a joker. The skill is timing the sale to double a tag you actually want.
test_idea: Which tag would you double right now? If the answer is 'none', Diet Cola is just an empty slot.

name: Driver's License
effect: X3 Mult if you have at least 16 Enhanced cards in your full deck
strategy: ×3 if your deck holds 16+ enhanced cards — the payoff for going all-in on Tarot sculpting. A win condition for enhancement decks, a fantasy otherwise.
test_idea: Count your enhanced cards. Under 10? Estimate the shops needed to hit 16 before committing the slot.
unlock: Enhance 16 cards in your deck

name: Droll Joker
effect: +10 Mult if played hand contains a Flush
strategy: +10 Mult on Flushes — the flush starter kit. Standard early buy, standard mid-game sell.
test_idea: Optimizer: Droll vs. The Tribe (×2) on your current flush — find the exact mult where ×2 overtakes +10.

name: Drunkard
effect: +1 discard each round
strategy: +1 discard per round: more selection every single round. Quietly enables combo digging and Castle/discard synergies — better than it looks, worse than a scorer.
test_idea: Theory: the extra discard converts ~1 losing blind per 2 antes into a win. Watch your close calls.

name: Dusk
effect: Retrigger all played cards in final hand of the round
strategy: Retriggers every played card on your final hand — a closer that doubles card-level value (steel, per-card jokers) when it matters most. Sequence rounds to end on your payoff hand.
test_idea: Toggle 'final hand' with Dusk in the optimizer — measure the retrigger premium on your standard play.

name: Egg
effect: Gains $3 of sell value at end of round
strategy: Gains $3 sell value each round — a savings account you eventually crack. The discipline is remembering it's an investment, not a keeper.
test_idea: Decide the sale ante in advance (usually when a real joker appears). Compare its total yield to interest income.

name: Erosion
effect: +4 Mult for each card below [the deck's starting size] in your full deck
strategy: +4 Mult for each card BELOW your deck's starting size — pays you to shred your own deck. Glass cards, Hanged Man, and purposeful destruction turn it into a real engine.
test_idea: After each destruction, update the count: at -6 cards it's +24 Mult. In the optimizer, find where it beats your ×1.5.

name: Even Steven
effect: Played cards with even rank give +4 Mult when scored (10, 8, 6, 4, 2)
strategy: +4 Mult per scored even card — a parity build's backbone. Sculpt toward 2/4/6/8/10 and every hand feeds it; ignore parity and it's a coin-flip bonus.
test_idea: Optimizer: an all-even Two Pair vs. a mixed Full House — parity discipline vs. raw hand rank.

name: Faceless Joker
effect: Earn $5 if 3 or more face cards are discarded at the same time
strategy: $5 when you discard 3+ face cards at once — turns dead face cards into payroll. Wants a fat, facey deck you're willing to dump from.
test_idea: One ante: how many triple-face discards did you actually assemble? Multiply by $5 and judge the slot.

name: Fibonacci
effect: Each played Ace, 2, 3, 5, or 8 gives +8 Mult when scored
strategy: +8 Mult on each scored A/2/3/5/8 — a rank-based engine that quietly loves straights (A-2-3-4-5 hits three Fibs). Sculpt ranks toward the sequence and it stacks fast.
test_idea: Optimizer: play A-2-3-5-8 'garbage' with Fibonacci vs. your best normal hand without it. Enjoy the result.

name: Flash Card
effect: This Joker gains +2 Mult per reroll in the shop
strategy: Gains +2 Mult per shop reroll — turns reroll costs into stat points. Reroll-heavy players get paid twice: better shops AND a growing engine.
test_idea: Enter its current +Mult each ante — does aggressive rerolling scale it past a flat +15 by ante 5?

name: Flower Pot
effect: X3 Mult if poker hand contains a Diamonds card, Clubs card, Hearts card, and Spades card
strategy: ×3 when all four suits score — rainbow hands on demand. Wild cards make it consistent; four-suit straights and junk 'rainbow' plays become premium hands.
test_idea: Optimizer: a deliberately rainbow High Card+stones play with ×3 vs. your mono-suit flush. Closer than you think?
unlock: Reach Ante level 8

name: Fortune Teller
effect: +1 Mult per Tarot card used this run
strategy: +1 Mult per Tarot used this run — a pedometer for your sculpting habit. In Tarot-heavy builds it's a free +15 by midgame.
test_idea: Count Tarots used so far; enter it in the optimizer. Is your habit already outscoring a purchased +Mult joker?

name: Four Fingers
effect: All Flushes and Straights can be made with 4 cards
strategy: 4-card flushes and straights change the entire hand-assembly math — you complete 25% more often and free a slot for a steel/glass passenger in every 'full' hand.
test_idea: Optimizer with Four Fingers on: your 4-card flush + 1 payoff passenger vs. a natural 5-card flush.

name: Gift Card
effect: Add $1 of sell value to every Joker and Consumable card at end of round
strategy: +$1 sell value to every joker and consumable each round — inflation for your whole shelf. Rewards wide boards you'll eventually liquidate.
test_idea: Before a big re-shelf, total the added sell value across the board — did Gift Card pay more than an Egg would have?

name: Glass Joker
effect: This Joker gains X0.75 Mult for every Glass Card that is destroyed
strategy: Gains ×0.75 per Glass card destroyed — the reason to CRACK glass, not protect it. Justice-enhanced junk cards become fuel: play them, break them, scale forever.
test_idea: Enter its current × after each shatter. Two breaks ≈ ×2.5 — check in the optimizer what that does to your closer.
unlock: Have at least 5 Glass Cards in your deck

name: Gluttonous Joker
effect: Played cards with Clubs suit give +3 Mult when scored
strategy: +3 Mult per scored Club — suit-mult filler. Only as good as your Club density; pairs naturally with The Moon tarot sculpting.
test_idea: Optimizer: your club flush with Gluttonous vs. without — then decide if the slot earns more than a scaler.

name: Golden Joker
effect: Earn $4 at end of round
strategy: Flat $4 per round — the benchmark all economy jokers are measured against. Boring, dependable, and exactly $4 better than nothing.
test_idea: Multiply remaining rounds × $4. If a shop joker can't beat that total in value, keep the gold.

name: Golden Ticket
effect: Played Gold cards earn $4 when scored
strategy: $4 per scored Gold card — makes Gold enhancement worth playing instead of just holding. Needs deliberate Devil-tarot investment to matter.
test_idea: Count your gold cards; estimate scored-per-round. Does the payout beat Golden Joker's flat $4? Usually needs 2+.
unlock: Play a 5 card hand that contains only Gold cards

name: Greedy Joker
effect: Played cards with Diamonds suit give +3 Mult when scored
strategy: +3 Mult per scored Diamond — same family as the other suit-mults. Buy to match your suit plan, not the other way around.
test_idea: Optimizer: quantify one round of diamond plays with vs. without — filler jokers deserve exact numbers too.

name: Green Joker
effect: +1 Mult per hand played, -1 Mult per discard
strategy: +1 Mult per hand played, -1 per discard — a metronome that rewards playing fast and loose with discards. Grows forever if you protect it.
test_idea: Enter its current value each ante. Theory: no-discard play makes Green outgrow Ride the Bus. Race them mentally.

name: Gros Michel
effect: +15 Mult, 1 in 6 chance this card is destroyed at end of round
strategy: +15 Mult with a 1-in-6 chance of dying each round. Great rate, real risk — ride it early, but never build a late-game plan on a banana.
test_idea: Expected lifespan ≈ 6 rounds. Did yours beat the odds? Log it — and never trust it for a boss you can't lose.

name: Hack
effect: Retrigger each played 2, 3, 4, or 5
strategy: Retriggers every scored 2/3/4/5 — low ranks score twice. Combined with Fibonacci (2,3,5) or lucky/steel low cards it turns 'bad' cards into the good cards.
test_idea: Optimizer: 2-3-4-5-x straight with Hack vs. 10-J-Q-K-A — the low straight wins by more than you'd guess.

name: Half Joker
effect: +20 Mult if played hand contains 3 or fewer cards
strategy: +20 Mult when playing 3 or fewer cards — pays you to play small. Absurd with strong pairs and held-card engines (Baron): tiny plays, big holds.
test_idea: Optimizer: 2-card pair + Half Joker + held Kings vs. a full 5-card hand — small-ball vs. big hand, head to head.

name: Hallucination
effect: 1 in 2 chance to create a Tarot card when any Booster Pack is opened (Must have room)
strategy: Coin-flip Tarot on every pack opened — passive sculpting income for players already buying packs. Zero effect if you skip shops.
test_idea: Track 5 packs: Tarots gained vs. the joker slot's opportunity cost. It's a rider, never a reason.

name: Hanging Chad
effect: Retrigger first played card used in scoring 2 additional times
strategy: Retriggers the FIRST scored card twice more — position play. Lead every hand with your most loaded card: glass, steel-adjacent, holo, lucky.
test_idea: Optimizer: put your polychrome card first vs. last in the played order — same cards, different score. Order is a stat.
unlock: Beat a Boss Blind with a High Card

name: Hiker
effect: Every played card permanently gains +5 Chips when scored
strategy: Every played card permanently gains +5 chips — your deck itself levels up. Favors playing MANY cards (Splash, five-card hands) and long runs; compounding you can feel by ante 6.
test_idea: Theory: by ante 5, Hiker has added +150 total chips across your regulars. Spot-check your most-played cards.

name: Hit the Road
effect: This Joker gains X0.5 Mult for every Jack discarded this round
strategy: Gains ×0.5 per discarded Jack this round — a per-round crescendo. Hoard Jacks, dump them in one round where you need a monster, accept the reset.
test_idea: Discard 3 Jacks (×2.5), enter it in the optimizer on your closer — plan exactly which blind deserves the show.
unlock: Discard 5 Jacks at the same time.

name: Hologram
effect: This Joker gains X0.25 Mult every time a playing card is added to your deck
strategy: Gains ×0.25 per card ADDED to your deck — the anti-thinning engine. Standard packs, Certificate, DNA all feed it; a fat-deck philosophy with a multiplier attached.
test_idea: Enter its current × each ante. Theory: 8 added cards (×3) beats any static joker in the shop. Watch it come true.

name: Ice Cream
effect: +100 Chips, -5 Chips for every hand played
strategy: +100 chips melting -5 per hand — strongest the moment you buy it. It's a rental: great for surviving THIS ante, gone in ~20 hands. Buy for emergencies, not futures.
test_idea: It hits zero in 20 hands. Count hands-per-ante in your log — how many antes is Ice Cream actually worth?

name: Invisible Joker
effect: After 2 rounds, sell this card to Duplicate a random Joker (Removes Negative from copy)
strategy: After 2 rounds, sell it to DUPLICATE a random joker — a lottery ticket that copies your board. Best on boards with one obvious jackpot and no duds to accidentally clone.
test_idea: Before selling: list your board. If fewer than half are worth duplicating, the coin flip is against you.
unlock: Win a run without ever having more than 4 Jokers

name: Joker
effect: +4 Mult
strategy: +4 Mult, no questions asked. The tutorial joker — and still correct to buy on ante 1 when the alternative is nothing. Replace without ceremony.
test_idea: Optimizer: measure exactly when +4 stops mattering on your curve. It's earlier than sentiment suggests.

name: Joker Stencil
effect: X1 Mult for each empty Joker slot, Joker Stencil included
strategy: ×1 per EMPTY joker slot — power through minimalism. A 1-2 joker board with Stencil beats many full boards; the discipline is not buying things.
test_idea: Optimizer: Stencil at ×4 (empty board) vs. your usual 5-joker spread. Let the math argue with your hoarding instinct.

name: Jolly Joker
effect: +8 Mult if played hand contains a Pair
strategy: +8 Mult on Pairs — the humble start of every pair-spam build. Cheap and cheerful; graduates to the sell pile by mid-run.
test_idea: Optimizer: Jolly on a lvl-3 Pair vs. The Duo's ×2 — find the crossover, sell on schedule.

name: Juggler
effect: +1 hand size
strategy: +1 hand size — more selection every hand, better flush/straight assembly, deeper holds for Baron-style builds. Invisible but everywhere.
test_idea: Theory: +1 hand size raises your average best-play score by ~10%. Sample five hands in the optimizer with 8 vs. 9 cards.

name: Loyalty Card
effect: X4 Mult every 6 hands played
strategy: ×4 every sixth hand — a metronome payoff. Count your hands and SAVE the ×4 for the hand that matters; wasting it on a small blind is the classic error.
test_idea: Plan a round in the optimizer: five setup hands then the ×4 closer vs. six flat hands. Rhythm beats rate.

name: Luchador
effect: Sell this card to disable the current Boss Blind
strategy: Sell it to disable the current boss blind — a one-shot Chicot. Carry it as insurance against your build's hard counter, spend it exactly once, exactly right.
test_idea: Name the one boss that ends your run. Luchador's whole value is that name — if you can't name it, sell now.

name: Lucky Cat
effect: This Joker gains X0.25 Mult every time a Lucky card successfully triggers
strategy: Gains ×0.25 every time a Lucky card triggers — turns gambling into compounding. Magician-tarot your low cards and every lucky proc is both Mult now AND × forever.
test_idea: Enter its current × each ante. Theory: 10 lucky procs (×3.5) arrives faster than Constellation's equivalent. Race them.

name: Lusty Joker
effect: Played cards with Hearts suit give +3 Mult when scored
strategy: +3 Mult per scored Heart — heart-suit filler. Same rules as its siblings: match your sculpting plan or skip.
test_idea: Optimizer: your heart-heavy hand with vs. without. If the delta bores you, the slot wants a scaler.

name: Mad Joker
effect: +10 Mult if played hand contains a Two Pair
strategy: +10 Mult on Two Pair — filler for the pair-spam lane. Two Pair is easy to assemble, so it triggers constantly; it just never scales.
test_idea: Optimizer: Two Pair + Mad vs. Full House bare — cheap consistency vs. rank. Which clears this blind?

name: Madness
effect: When Small Blind or Big Blind is selected, gain X0.5 Mult and destroy a random Joker
strategy: Gains ×0.5 each blind selected — but DESTROYS a random other joker each time. A deal with the devil: feed it junk early and it outgrows everything; feed it your engine and weep.
test_idea: Board math: with 2 protected keepers and 2 sacrifices, how many blinds until Madness (×3+) has paid for the funerals?

name: Mail-In Rebate
effect: Earn $5 for each discarded [rank], rank changes every round
strategy: $5 per discarded card of a chosen rank (changes each round) — turns targeted discards into income. Check the rank every round; sometimes the discard IS the play.
test_idea: One ante: dollars earned chasing the rebate rank vs. hands weakened by chasing it. Net it out honestly.

name: Marble Joker
effect: Adds one Stone card to the deck when Blind is selected
strategy: Adds a Stone card to your deck each blind — stones always score (+50 chips) but never make hands. Great with Splash/Stone Joker; quiet dilution otherwise.
test_idea: Optimizer: your flush with one stone passenger scored vs. five natural cards — is +50 worth the dead draw?

name: Matador
effect: Earn $8 if played hand triggers the Boss Blind ability
strategy: $8 when the boss blind's ability triggers — pays you for walking into the punch. Best against bosses whose trigger is constant; useless against one-shot effects.
test_idea: Before each boss: will its ability trigger 2+ times? If yes, Matador out-earns Golden Joker this round.
unlock: Defeat a Boss Blind in 1 hand without using any discards

name: Merry Andy
effect: +3 discards each round, -1 hand size
strategy: +3 discards but -1 hand size — digging power at the cost of selection. Loves discard engines (Castle, Hit the Road, rebates); hurts big-hand assembly.
test_idea: Theory: with Castle on board, Merry Andy's extra discards scale more chips than the lost hand-size costs. Track one ante.
unlock: Win a run in 12 or fewer rounds

name: Midas Mask
effect: All played face cards become Gold cards when scored
strategy: Played face cards turn Gold — combos with Golden Ticket into a face-card mint. Without Ticket it's mostly making your faces worth holding, not playing.
test_idea: Pair test: Midas + Golden Ticket for one ante — total the $ from gilded faces vs. two economy jokers.

name: Mime
effect: Retrigger all card held in hand abilities
strategy: Retriggers all held-in-hand effects — Baron's soulmate. Steel cards and held Kings double-dip; the entire held-hand archetype starts here.
test_idea: Optimizer: Baron + 2 held Kings, then imagine each King triggering twice (×1.5→×2.25 each). That's Mime.

name: Misprint
effect: +0-23 Mult
strategy: +0 to +23 Mult, random every hand — averages a solid +11.5 with pure chaos attached. Fine early; the variance is a tax on planning must-win hands.
test_idea: Compare EV vs. Optimist mode in the optimizer — if the worst roll loses you the blind, Misprint isn't a real +11.

name: Mr. Bones
effect: Prevents Death if chips scored are at least 25% of required chips, self destructs
strategy: Saves you from death once (if you scored 25%+ of the blind), then leaves. A run-insurance policy — its value is every risky line you get to take BECAUSE it exists.
test_idea: Count the greedy plays you made only because Bones was there. That freedom, not the rescue, is the product.
unlock: Lose 5 runs

name: Mystic Summit
effect: +15 Mult when 0 discards remaining
strategy: +15 Mult when you're on 0 discards — rewards either spending them all fast or running Burglar's no-discard life. Timing joker: your LAST hands each round get the bonus.
test_idea: Optimizer: your closer at +15 (discards spent) — worth sequencing discards early every round? Usually yes.

name: Obelisk
effect: This Joker gains X0.2 Mult per consecutive hand played without playing your most played poker hand
strategy: Gains ×0.2 per hand played that is NOT your most-played hand — pays you for variety and punishes one-trick decks. Weird, and weirdly strong with balanced builds.
test_idea: Track it one run: does deliberately rotating hand types keep Obelisk above ×2 without wrecking your levels?

name: Odd Todd
effect: Played cards with odd rank give +31 Chips when scored (A, 9, 7, 5, 3)
strategy: +31 chips per scored odd card — Even Steven's mirror. Ace counts. Parity-sculpted decks turn every hand into a chip engine.
test_idea: Optimizer: all-odd hand (A/3/5/7/9) with Todd vs. mixed — parity discipline priced in chips.

name: Onyx Agate
effect: Played cards with Clubs suit give +7 Mult when scored
strategy: +7 Mult per scored Club — the biggest suit-mult. Club flushes with Agate are a genuine early engine, not just filler.
test_idea: Optimizer: 5-club flush = +35 Mult from Agate alone. Compare against The Tribe's ×2 at your current mult.
unlock: Have at least 30 cards with Club suit in your deck

name: Oops! All 6s
effect: Doubles all listed probabilities (ex: 1 in 3 -> 2 in 3)
strategy: Doubles all listed probabilities — lucky cards hit 1-in-2, Bloodstone flips get friendly, Wheel of Fortune stops insulting you. A build enabler for gambling decks.
test_idea: Optimist vs. EV mode in the optimizer approximates its effect on lucky builds — measure the uplift, then imagine it real.
unlock: In one hand, earn at least 10,000 chips

name: Pareidolia
effect: All cards are considered face cards
strategy: EVERY card is a face card — Business Card pays on everything, Scary Face/Smiley Face trigger always, Sock and Buskin retriggers everything. A whole archetype in one slot.
test_idea: Optimizer: toggle Pareidolia with Sock and Buskin — every card scoring twice turns junk hands into engines.

name: Perkeo
effect: Creates a Negative copy of 1 random consumable card in your possession at the end of the shop
strategy: Legendary: duplicates a random consumable at shop exit — infinite copies of whatever you're hoarding. Park a Black Hole or key Tarot and let the printer run.
test_idea: Hold exactly one premium consumable through 3 shops — count the copies. That's compounding you can plan around.
unlock: Find this Joker from the Soul card.

name: Photograph
effect: First played face card gives X2 Mult when scored
strategy: First scored face card gets ×2 — a positional payoff. Lead with your best face; combos with retriggers and face-heavy sculpting.
test_idea: Optimizer: face card first vs. buried in the order — quantify the leading-face premium on your usual hand.

name: Popcorn
effect: +20 Mult, -4 Mult per round played
strategy: +20 Mult shrinking -4 per round — strongest today, gone by Friday. Like Ice Cream, it's a rental for the current wall, not a plan.
test_idea: Five rounds to zero: does it bridge you to the next real engine? If nothing's coming, the slot is dying capital.

name: Raised Fist
effect: Adds double the rank of lowest ranked card held in hand to Mult
strategy: Adds double the rank of your LOWEST held card as Mult — hold a King low (20 Mult) or exploit it with deliberately tall holds. The trick: your hand's floor becomes the stat.
test_idea: Optimizer: same play holding a 2 vs. holding a King as the lowest card — watch the held-hand composition move the score.

name: Ramen
effect: X2 Mult, loses X0.01 Mult per card discarded
strategy: ×2 that loses ×0.01 per discarded card — a melting multiplier. No-discard discipline keeps it near-permanent; discard-heavy builds dissolve it in three antes.
test_idea: At your discard rate, compute its half-life. Under Banner-style play does Ramen effectively become a permanent ×2?

name: Red Card
effect: This Joker gains +3 Mult when any Booster Pack is skipped
strategy: +3 Mult per booster pack SKIPPED — pays you for shop discipline. An economy-adjacent scaler: skip packs, bank money, grow mult. Triple win for tight players.
test_idea: Enter its current value each ante — does pack-skipping scale it past +15 by ante 4 while your wallet also grows?

name: Reserved Parking
effect: Each face card held in hand has a 1 in 2 chance to give $1
strategy: Face cards held in hand coin-flip $1 each hand — passive income from cards you were hoarding anyway. Baron-style King-holders get paid twice.
test_idea: One ante of King-hoarding: total the parking meter. It's small — but it's rent on cards doing other jobs.

name: Ride the Bus
effect: This Joker gains +1 Mult per consecutive hand played without a scoring face card
strategy: +1 Mult per consecutive hand WITHOUT face cards; resets when one scores. The classic discipline engine — sculpt faces out or never play them, and it grows forever.
test_idea: Enter its current value each ante. Theory: a faceless deck rides it past +20 by ante 6. Your log will settle it.

name: Riff-Raff
effect: When Blind is selected, create 2 Common Jokers (Must have room)
strategy: Two free Common jokers each blind — board-filler that feeds Ceremonial Dagger, sell-value engines, and Baseball-adjacent shenanigans. Value is what you DO with the freebies.
test_idea: With Dagger or Gift Card on board, total one ante of freebie value. Without them? It's clutter with a smile.

name: Rocket
effect: Earn $1 at end of round. Payout increases by $2 when Boss Blind is defeated
strategy: Pays $1/round, +$2 permanently each boss beaten — compound interest with a fuse. Early purchase compounds; late purchase never catches Golden Joker.
test_idea: Compute its cumulative payout from THIS ante to run's end vs. Golden Joker's flat $4 — the crossover ante decides.

name: Rough Gem
effect: Played cards with Diamonds suit earn $1 when scored
strategy: $1 per scored Diamond — a toll booth on a suit you're already playing. Diamond-flush builds collect passively; anyone else shrugs.
test_idea: One ante of diamond plays: does the toll beat Golden Joker's $4? Needs ~5 scored diamonds a round.
unlock: Have at least 30 cards with Diamond suit in your deck

name: Runner
effect: Gains +15 Chips if played hand contains a Straight
strategy: Gains +15 chips per Straight played — a chip engine that rewards commitment to the straight lane. With Shortcut/Four Fingers it compounds quickly.
test_idea: Enter its current chips each ante — five straights in (+75) it rivals fixed chip jokers and keeps going.

name: Satellite
effect: Earn $1 at end of round per unique Planet card used this run
strategy: $1 per round per unique Planet used this run — economy that scales with your celestial habit. Astronomer feeds it; by late game it out-earns Golden Joker.
test_idea: Count unique planets used; that's your per-round payout. Find the ante where it passed $4 — earlier than you thought?
unlock: Have at least $400.

name: Scary Face
effect: Played face cards give +30 Chips when scored
strategy: +30 chips per scored face card — face-density filler that Pareidolia upgrades to 'every card'. Honest chips for royal-heavy decks.
test_idea: Optimizer: K-Q-J heavy hand with vs. without — then add Pareidolia to see the ceiling.

name: Scholar
effect: Played Aces give +20 Chips and +4 Mult when scored
strategy: Aces give +20 chips AND +4 Mult — makes every Ace a dual-stat card. Ace-retention plans (DNA copies, Hack? no—Aces aren't retriggered by Hack) love it.
test_idea: Optimizer: pair of Aces + Scholar vs. pair of Kings + nothing — the Ace premium, quantified.

name: Seeing Double
effect: X2 Mult if played hand has a scoring Clubs card and a scoring card of any other suit
strategy: ×2 when a Club scores alongside another suit — a two-suit handshake. Club-plus-anything hands are easy to sculpt; wild cards make it near-automatic.
test_idea: Optimizer: club-inclusive flush-five vs. mono-heart — is keeping one club lane worth a standing ×2?
unlock: Play a hand that contains four 7 of Clubs

name: Seltzer
effect: Retrigger all cards played for the next 10 hands
strategy: Retriggers ALL played cards for 10 hands — a rental Dusk-for-every-hand. Ten hands of double value: schedule it for the ante you must crush.
test_idea: Optimizer: your standard play doubled per-card vs. normal — multiply by 10 hands; that's Seltzer's total value.

name: Shoot the Moon
effect: Each Queen held in hand gives +13 Mult
strategy: +13 Mult per Queen HELD in hand — Baron's little sister. Queen-hoarding with cheap plays stacks fast; Mime retriggers make it silly.
test_idea: Optimizer: hold 3 Queens (+39 Mult) behind a tiny pair — versus playing 'real' hands. Held-hand builds in one experiment.
unlock: Play every Heart card in your deck in one round.

name: Shortcut
effect: Allows Straights to be made with gaps of 1 rank (ex: 10 8 6 5 3)
strategy: Straights can skip one rank (e.g. 3-5-7-9-J) — straight assembly stops being a lottery. The enabler that makes straight builds actually consistent.
test_idea: Optimizer with Shortcut on: count how many of your last 8 hands contain a gapped straight you'd have missed.

name: Showman
effect: Joker, Tarot, Planet, and Spectral cards may appear multiple times
strategy: Jokers and consumables can appear as duplicates — enables double-Blueprint fantasies and consumable stacking. A rule-bender for combo enjoyers with a plan.
test_idea: Name the card you want a second copy of. No answer = no Showman. With an answer, it's a build unlock.
unlock: Reach Ante level 4

name: Sixth Sense
effect: If first hand of round is a single 6, destroy it and create a Spectral card (Must have room)
strategy: Destroy a played lone 6 → gain a Spectral card. Spectrals are the game's wildest sculpting tools; a 6-recycling routine prints them.
test_idea: Keep two 6s alive for three antes: how many Spectrals did the ritual print, and what did they let you build?

name: Sly Joker
effect: +50 Chips if played hand contains a Pair
strategy: +50 chips on Pairs — day-one filler. The first joker you buy and the first you sell, as tradition demands.
test_idea: Optimizer: exactly how many antes until +50 chips stops covering blind inflation? Set a sell reminder.

name: Smeared Joker
effect: Hearts and Diamonds count as the same suit, Spades and Clubs count as the same suit
strategy: Hearts=Diamonds, Spades=Clubs — your four-suit deck becomes two suits and flushes nearly double in frequency. Ancient Joker and suit-mults get twice the targets.
test_idea: Optimizer with Smeared on: count flushes in your next 8 hands vs. the 8 before. The rate change IS the argument.
unlock: Have at least 3 Wild Card in your deck

name: Smiley Face
effect: Played face cards give +5 Mult when scored
strategy: +5 Mult per scored face card — the Mult twin of Scary Face. Face-heavy plays love it; Pareidolia makes it universal.
test_idea: Optimizer: 3-face hand = +15 Mult. Compare with Scary Face's +90 chips on the same hand — which half do you need?

name: Sock and Buskin
effect: Retrigger all played face cards
strategy: Retriggers ALL scored face cards — the face-build engine room. Photograph, Midas, Smiley/Scary, steel faces: everything face-flavored doubles.
test_idea: Optimizer: pair of Kings with vs. without — then stack Photograph and watch the first King get absurd.
unlock: Play a total of 300 face cards

name: Space Joker
effect: 1 in 4 chance to upgrade level of played poker hand
strategy: 1-in-4 chance to level your played hand each play — free planet-drip on your most-played hand. Passive, variance-y, quietly compounding for one-hand decks.
test_idea: Over 20 plays expect ~5 free levels. Check your run log: did your main hand's level match the math?

name: Spare Trousers
effect: This Joker gains +2 Mult if played hand contains a Two Pair
strategy: Gains +2 Mult every time you play Two Pair — the pair-spam pedometer. Two Pair is the easiest hand to assemble on demand, so it scales on autopilot.
test_idea: Enter its current value each ante — ten Two Pairs in (+20) it beats every flat Mult joker. Time the crossover.

name: Splash
effect: Every played card counts in scoring
strategy: EVERY played card scores — junk cards become chip donors and per-card jokers trigger on all five. Redefines 'best hand' toward biggest pile.
test_idea: Optimizer with Splash: a pair plus three fat off-cards vs. the clean pair — watch the garbage earn wages.

name: Square Joker
effect: This Joker gains +4 Chips if played hand has exactly 4 cards
strategy: Gains +4 chips per 4-card hand played — with Four Fingers making 4-card flushes/straights standard, it scales on your natural rhythm.
test_idea: Enter its current chips each ante alongside Four Fingers — is the 4-card lifestyle feeding it 3+ times a round?

name: Steel Joker
effect: Gives X0.2 Mult for each Steel Card in your full deck
strategy: ×0.2 per Steel card in your DECK (not hand) — the payoff for Chariot-tarot investment. Five steels = ×2 always-on, no holding required.
test_idea: Count your steels; enter the implied × in the optimizer. Compare against Baron's held-King alternative for the same Tarots.

name: Stone Joker
effect: Gives +25 Chips for each Stone Card in your full deck
strategy: +25 chips per Stone card in deck — Marble Joker's payoff. A stone-manufacturing pipeline turns dead cards into a permanent chip wall.
test_idea: With Marble adding one stone per blind, project the chips two antes out — when does it pass +100 standing?

name: Stuntman
effect: +250 Chips, -2 hand size
strategy: +250 chips for -2 hand size — a huge battery with a real cost: worse selection, harder flushes. Best when your hand type is cheap to assemble (pairs) or your holds are small.
test_idea: Optimizer: your usual play +250 chips vs. the better hands 2 extra cards would find. The trade, in numbers.
unlock: Earn at least 100 million (100,000,000) Chips in a single hand.

name: Supernova
effect: Adds the number of times poker hand has been played this run to Mult
strategy: Adds the number of times you've played this hand type as Mult — one-trick decks turn repetition itself into a stat. Your 40th flush brings +40.
test_idea: Check your most-played count; that's Supernova's value on that hand. When does it pass your flat-Mult filler?

name: Superposition
effect: Create a Tarot card if poker hand contains an Ace and a Straight (Must have room)
strategy: Straight containing an Ace → free Tarot. A-2-3-4-5 (or Shortcut gaps) becomes a Tarot vending machine for straight builds.
test_idea: Three Ace-straights = three Tarots. Worth bending toward the wheel straight? Count what the Tarots bought you.

name: Swashbuckler
effect: Adds the sell value of all other owned Jokers to Mult
strategy: Adds the sell value of your OTHER jokers as Mult — a board-worth meter. Gift Card inflates it; expensive boards make it a genuine engine.
test_idea: Total your board's sell value; that's the +Mult. Does buying pricier jokers now carry a hidden double payoff?
unlock: Sell a total of 20 Joker cards

name: Séance
effect: If poker hand is a Straight Flush, create a random Spectral card (Must have room)
strategy: Straight Flush → free Spectral card. The rarest hand prints the rarest consumable — mono-suit straight builds get a jackpot rider.
test_idea: If you land one Straight Flush per two antes, is the Spectral stream worth a slot? Only committed builds say yes.

name: The Duo
effect: X2 Mult if played hand contains a Pair
strategy: ×2 if the hand CONTAINS a Pair — the easiest condition in the multiplicative family. Full houses, two pairs, trips all qualify; it's a near-unconditional ×2 for pair-adjacent decks.
test_idea: Optimizer: stack The Duo with one more ×2 on a full house — multiplicative stacking (×4, not +4) in one glance.
unlock: Win a run without playing a Pair.

name: The Family
effect: X4 Mult if played hand contains a Four of a Kind
strategy: ×4 on hands containing Four of a Kind — the biggest conditional × on the tightest condition. DNA-duplicated ranks and rank-sculpting make it reachable.
test_idea: Optimizer: your best quads with ×4 vs. your best flush with ×2 — which archetype's ceiling is truly higher?
unlock: Win a run without playing a Four of a Kind.

name: The Idol
effect: Each played [rank] of [suit] gives X2 Mult when scored, Card changes every round
strategy: ×2 per scored copy of a specific card (changes each round) — a lottery you can rig with duplicated decks (DNA, Cryptid). Random for tourists, an engine for engineers.
test_idea: Set the Idol card in the optimizer to one you hold 3 copies of — watch ×8 appear from 'random'.
unlock: In one hand, earn at least 1,000,000 chips

name: The Order
effect: X3 Mult if played hand contains a Straight
strategy: ×3 on hands containing a Straight — the straight lane's big payoff. With Shortcut/Four Fingers feeding consistency, it's the reason the archetype works.
test_idea: Optimizer: straight + The Order vs. flush + The Tribe at equal levels — settle the lane rivalry with numbers.
unlock: Win a run without playing a Straight.

name: The Tribe
effect: X2 Mult if played hand contains a Flush
strategy: ×2 on hands containing a Flush — the flush build's standing multiplier. Unconditional in a mono-suit deck; the first 'real engine' most flush runs buy.
test_idea: Optimizer: your flush with Tribe alone vs. Tribe + Blueprint copying it — ×2 vs. ×4 is the whole endgame plan.
unlock: Win a run without playing a Flush.

name: The Trio
effect: X3 Mult if played hand contains a Three of a Kind
strategy: ×3 on hands containing Three of a Kind — trips/full-house decks' payoff. Harder condition than The Duo, bigger reward; rank-sculpting makes it reliable.
test_idea: Optimizer: full house with Trio (qualifies) vs. two pair with Duo — condition difficulty priced against payout.
unlock: Win a run without playing a Three of a Kind.

name: Throwback
effect: X0.25 Mult for each Blind skipped this run
strategy: ×0.25 per blind SKIPPED this run — pays you for skipping. Skip-heavy routes (tag farming) accumulate a permanent ×; a strategy joker that rewards route planning.
test_idea: Two skips = ×1.5 standing. Plan a skip-heavy route and enter the final × — did the skipped shops cost less than it pays?
unlock: Continue a saved run from the main menu

name: To Do List
effect: Earn $4 if poker hand is a [Poker Hand], poker hand changes at end of round
strategy: $4 when you play the listed hand (changes each round) — a small bounty for flexibility. One-trick decks collect rarely; flexible players farm it.
test_idea: One ante: how many bounties did you actually hit without distorting your play? That number decides the slot.

name: To the Moon
effect: Earn an extra $1 of interest for every $5 you have at end of round
strategy: +$1 interest per $5 held (on top of base interest) — doubles down on the hoarding lifestyle. With a fat bank it's the best pure economy card in the game.
test_idea: At $25+ held it pays $5/round. Compute three rounds of compound difference vs. Golden Joker — hoarders win big.

name: Trading Card
effect: If first discard of round has only 1 card, destroy it and earn $3
strategy: First discard of exactly ONE card destroys it and pays $3 — deck-thinning that PAYS. Surgical removal of your worst card every single round.
test_idea: One card thinner + $3, every round. After one ante, is your draw quality visibly better? Erosion says hi, too.

name: Triboulet
effect: Played Kings and Queens each give X2 Mult when scored
strategy: Legendary: scored Kings and Queens give ×2 EACH. A royal-court engine — K/Q pairs hit ×4, and with retriggers the numbers stop being polite.
test_idea: Optimizer: pair of Kings under Triboulet (×4) then add Sock and Buskin — watch retriggered royalty break the banner.
unlock: Find this Joker from the Soul card.

name: Troubadour
effect: +2 hand size, -1 hand each round
strategy: +2 hand size, -1 hand per round — deeper selection, fewer swings. Big-hand assembly builds (flush five, straight flush hunts) accept the tempo tax.
test_idea: Theory: with 10-card selection your best-play average rises enough to need fewer hands anyway. Sample it in the optimizer.
unlock: Win 5 consecutive rounds by playing only 1 hand

name: Turtle Bean
effect: +5 hand size, reduces by 1 each round
strategy: +5 hand size, shrinking by 1 each round — a rental Troubadour without the tempo cost. Ride the giant hands while they last.
test_idea: Five rounds of shrinking selection: schedule your hardest blind inside the window and check the difference.

name: Vagabond
effect: Create a Tarot card if hand is played with $4 or less
strategy: Free Tarot when you end a hand with $4 or less — pays you for being broke. Pairs beautifully with Credit Card spending: stay poor, print Tarots.
test_idea: Three broke hands = three Tarots. Deliberately spend down for an ante — did the Tarot stream out-value the interest lost?

name: Vampire
effect: This Joker gains X0.1 Mult per scoring Enhanced card played, removes card Enhancement
strategy: Gains ×0.1 per Enhanced card played — but REMOVES the enhancement. It eats your steel/glass/lucky investments to grow. Feed it cheap enhancements, never your engine pieces.
test_idea: Enter its current × each ante — after eating 10 throwaway enhancements (×2) has it repaid what it consumed?

name: Walkie Talkie
effect: Each played 10 or 4 gives +10 Chips and +4 Mult when scored
strategy: Every scored 10 or 4 gives +10 chips +4 Mult — a dual-stat battery on two ranks. 10s appear in every big straight; 4s in wheel straights. Quietly everywhere.
test_idea: Optimizer: 4-5-6-7-8 + Walkie vs. 10-J-Q-K-A + Walkie — which straight family feeds it better with your deck?

name: Wee Joker
effect: This Joker gains +8 Chips when each played 2 is scored
strategy: Gains +8 chips per scored 2 — the reason to hoard and retrigger 2s (Hack doubles every trigger). A meme that becomes a monster in dedicated deuce decks.
test_idea: Enter its current chips each ante with Hack on board — deuce-spam for one ante and watch the line go vertical.
unlock: Win a run in 18 or fewer rounds

name: Wily Joker
effect: +100 Chips if played hand contains a Three of a Kind
strategy: +100 chips on Three of a Kind — trips-lane filler. Same lifecycle as its cousins: bridge, then sell.
test_idea: Optimizer: trips + Wily vs. two pair + Mad — the filler civil war, settled at your current levels.

name: Wrathful Joker
effect: Played cards with Spades suit give +3 Mult when scored
strategy: +3 Mult per scored Spade — spade filler; Arrowhead's Mult-flavored sibling. Match to your suit plan.
test_idea: Optimizer: spade flush with Wrathful + Arrowhead together — is the dedicated spade package worth two slots?

name: Yorick
effect: This Joker gains X1 Mult every 23 cards discarded
strategy: Legendary: gains ×1 per 23 cards discarded — the discard build's endgame. Merry Andy + discard engines feed the skull; it never resets, only grows.
test_idea: Enter its current × each ante. At your discard rate, when does Yorick hit ×3 — and what else could those slots have scaled by then?
unlock: Find this Joker from the Soul card.

name: Zany Joker
effect: +12 Mult if played hand contains a Three of a Kind
strategy: +12 Mult on Three of a Kind — trips filler with a bigger number. The archetype's training wheels.
test_idea: Optimizer: find the exact ante where Zany's +12 loses to a ×1.5 on your curve — schedule the trade.
